meta.title: The stimulus, before any drug
meta.sub: matched control wells, patient 706 (t3), late timepoint; toggle the AI outline

left.label: Unstimulated control
left.note: Left alone, the well is a looser, more diffuse cluster.

right.label: Stimulated control (activation cocktail)
right.note: IL-2/15/21 + CpG, a microenvironment mimic, tightens the cluster: it becomes denser and more cohesive.

note: The activation cocktail alone, with no drug, makes the spheroid more cohesive (a downward shift in inferred cell-cell adhesion J_cc). Every drug effect in this theme is measured relative to this stimulated state, which is why a drug that 'loosens' is really pushing the spheroid back toward the unstimulated look.
